title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing — Episode4 Just as You Are

meta.Event Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: A few hours later
The Lumina Forum - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everything went so badly...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I did my best to express my opinions when we were in the meeting room and stream studio... But I kept swinging and missing.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want everyone to focus on MORE MORE JUMP!, but I feel like things just went from bad to worse...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori? The baths are this way, not that way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, sorry...!
Hehe. I didn't mean to space out there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Get a hold of yourself, Minori!
We don't need you copying Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's right, Minori.
Getting lost is my specialty, so I'd rather you didn't take that away from me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What do you mean “specialty”?!
Promise to never write that on your resume, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, Minori...?
se_walk_women_005_1
se_walk_women_005_2

*Sigh*
That was such a nice bath! I feel like chugging a whole bottle of milk now!

You sound like an old man.
Also, you really gotta stop doing that thing where you put a hand on your hip while you brush your teeth.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
Oh, it's MMJ!
Are you all heading over to the baths now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, since we decided to eat first.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, Shizuku and Arisa are having a stare down!>
<Are they gonna go at each other like they did during iHaz?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I forgot... Everyone's watching all of this...!)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Your timing couldn't have been better...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You may've left, but we still came up together. It wouldn't be right of me not to properly greet my rival, no?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Also, this seems like a good opportunity to finally settle things between us.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: By seeing who is actually better.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to do that as well.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh? Are you accepting my challenge?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Remember what I said last time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know not to run away from my responsibilities or ask others to safeguard me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I was still in Cheerful * Days, I wasn't able to lead everyone properly. Instead, I ended up causing you all a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But things are different now. I plan on using the light within me to lead MORE MORE JUMP! forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, Arisa, I don't plan on losing to you.
Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Sounds like you've finally grown a spine.
But a big mouth will only get you so far...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Stop it, Arisa! I know you two have history, but this is getting way too tense!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, honestly!
This is what you call a greeting?!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: It's good, right?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We're not here to shoot the breeze. This is a broadcast program, after all.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Those two really mean business...!>
<I can't look away.>
<You guys have to include this in the weekly digest!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Arisa did all that to get everyone's attention...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that's not all...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Anyway, that's everything I wanted to say, so I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. Let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Those two are fully prepared to go head-to-head...)
One hour later
Bedroom

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This really is a wonderful room.
The sofa looks very comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I bet the second I sit down, I won't feel like ever getting back up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't see any problem with that since the bedrooms aren't being filmed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
There aren't any cameras in here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, are you sure you're okay?
You just collapsed like you'd used the last ounce of your energy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... So much relief just washed over me that I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You did try your very best today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But things didn't go so well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...
<Girls!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I came to visit!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Us too♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<We're sorry for dropping by so suddenly.
The thing is, we've been peeking at what's going on with the program. We decided to pop out after hearing that there aren't any cameras in this room.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Nice work today!
We could tell just how heated the competition at this grand prix is!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And the way you interacted with your rivals was so dramatic...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <KAITO, have you forgotten that we're here to ask what Minori and them thought?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh no! I-I'm sorry...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We're glad that you enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ahem... Anyway, how did the first day of the grand prix go?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't do very well today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wait, you think so?
I really enjoyed seeing you talk with Hikarin and everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the others had to help me a lot with that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did get a pretty good response, so I really don't think you should be so hard on yourself... But you did seem more nervous than normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I was.
I thought I was ready for this grand prix since it's such a hugely important event...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I kept thinking, “You have to do everything you can to get noticed,” which ended up overwhelming me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I see...
You're all used to doing streams, but this one takes place over a much longer period...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And it can't be easy to get everyone's attention when there are so many other idols around.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: The Sparkly Shooting Star is the biiig meteor I rode on to get to this planet☆

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We're not here to shoot the breeze. This is a broadcast program, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others all took advantage of the opportunities that they were given...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They made things more exciting or bumped heads with those around them, while also making sure to get in something about themselves...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It feels like their resolve is on a different level compared to mine when it comes to this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I feel like I didn't prepare enough...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that fact became clear to me today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm going to make the most of this revelation by not messing up tomorrow! I'm gonna keep trying harder and harder and harder!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <How about you try to relax a little, Minori?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I understand exactly how you feel...
After all, this program is an enormous opportunity for MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wanting more people to watch you. Wanting to spread more hope. Those desires are making you fret.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I think you're a wonderful idol just the way you currently are, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Your fans and I all want to support you because you don't act. We like you for who you are as a person.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, I feel that you shouldn't pressure yourself to be better or more noticeable.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Even if you stumble, I'm certain that somebody out there will feel inspired by the way you're always doing your best.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's hard not to feel anxious when you're surrounded by so many impressive idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you're an idol who's able to spread hope to others just by being yourself, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, you should have more confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Now I see...
I was putting way too much pressure on myself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to go out there tomorrow, not worry so much and be more and more and more like myself!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you just gotta give everyone a big dose of who you really are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That being said, we still have to do a debrief. You ready...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes, I'm ready!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's a good call.
Since everyone's here, we should hear their thoughts while we reflect on everything that happened and prepare for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm looking forward to hearing your criticism!
